title: query-table v3 query protocol
description: Every JSON value that crosses the v3 query wire: the capabilities handshake, QueryRequestV3 and QueryResultV3. This file is the source of truth; tools/wire-codegen generates the TypeScript, Go and Swift types from it. Property order is the Go struct (and so Go encoding) order. See docs/wire-protocol.md.

FilterOp.description: Filter operators. Every value can be NULL, so is_null/is_not_null are valid for every field type.

WhereClause.description: One predicate. `value` is the raw string the UI captured; executors coerce it by the field's declared type. Datetime comparisons also accept signed offsets such as "-1h" relative to `now`. `negated` is a null-exclusive NOT, set only for ops without a complement.

WhereConjunction.description: One branch of an OR group that ANDs several literals. Branches do not nest.

WhereBranch.description: One alternative of an OR group: a literal or a conjunction.

OrGroup.description: A disjunction of literals or conjunctions: (a AND b) OR c.

WhereTerm.description: One conjunct of a WHERE: a literal or an OR group. A WHERE is the AND of its terms; every literal counts against the 100-predicate budget.

RegexExtract.description: Sort by the first capture group of a regex match (or the whole match); a non-match is NULL.

OrderByClause.description: One ORDER BY term; array order is sort priority.

AggOp.description: A single aggregate operation; only count needs no measure field.

MetricDateGrouping.description: Calendar grouping of the first group key. Calendar intervals key a bucket by its start instant; hourOfDay (0-23) and dayOfWeek (ISO 1-7) key a slot by number. Whole intervals and occurrences are planned by the client into plain calendar metrics and never cross the wire.

every.description: Calendar intervals only: buckets of this many intervals, anchored as CalendarGroupKey.every describes; omitted is 1. Cycles refuse values above 1.

includeEmpty.description: Add a bucket for every interval of the range.

MetricDisplayHint.description: The only display state on the wire: scatter pairs `expression` with `expressionY`.

MetricDistribution.description: A box or histogram over `input` per group instead of a scalar value.

MetricMinCount.description: Drop small groups before sorting, groupLimit and Other: a number counts rows; an object counts a field's distinct non-null values or sums a numeric field. Removed groups are reported as hiddenGroups.

MetricSpec.description: One metric as sent: an AggregationClause without its presentation (label, layout, display other than scatter, window, share).

expression.description: A formula over aggregates; replaces op/field.

field.description: Measure field; omitted only for count.

where.description: The metric's own predicate, ANDed with the table WHERE.

CalendarGroupKey.description: A grouping key that buckets a datetime field by calendar interval, keyed by the interval's start instant. Weeks start on Monday.

every.description: Buckets of this many intervals; omitted is 1. Anchors are fixed: hours dividing 24 start at local multiples of every within each day (other counts are elapsed blocks from 1970-01-01T00:00Z, whatever the timeZone), days count local dates from 1970-01-01, weeks from Monday 1969-12-29, months from January 1970 and years from 1970.

GroupKey.description: A field name (group by exact value) or a calendar key.

SummaryColumn.description: One summary column of a grouping stage. Display and link columns are client-only.

RepresentativeRow.description: The ordering that picks each group's representative row for ROW summaries.

GroupingDefinition.description: One grouping stage over the complete source population; the result stage's where is HAVING.

HostQueryState.description: Query state a host owns and registers with useQueryTable({ hostQuery }), such as a keyword clause it runs itself. It travels with the table query through saves, links, history and resets. params are named lists of strings, like URL search parameters, sorted by name; the host interprets them. Query Table passes it through uninterpreted. Version 0 marks a payload that could not be read and is always rejected on restore.

DistinctRequestV3.description: Distinct values of one server-filterable field: a literal, case-insensitive substring match on the value as text (empty matches all), ordered by count desc then value asc. textarray fields contribute each element.

metricMinCount.description: Executes a numeric minCount and reports hiddenGroups.

calendarCycles.description: Executes the hourOfDay and dayOfWeek intervals.

calendarEvery.description: Executes multi-interval buckets: MetricDateGrouping.every and CalendarGroupKey.every.

QueryRequestV3.description: One v3 query: rows, metrics, groups or distinct values. source.where runs before grouping; result selects, filters (HAVING) and pages.

expectedRevisions.description: Computed definition id to the revision the client planned with.

distinct.description: Filter-value suggestions over source.where; requires rows false, no metrics and no grouping.

hostState.description: Host-owned state, passed through uninterpreted: any JSON object. Query Table's TypeScript client sends a HostQueryState ({ version, params }); a host defines what its own clients send.

MetricValue.description: A metric value or group key: a number for count/sum/avg, the column's value for min/max; null when undefined. Go carries it as any, Swift as JSONValue.

summary.description: null when the group has no numeric samples.

MetricHistogramDistribution.description: Bin i is edges[i] <= value < edges[i+1]; the final bin includes its upper edge.

x-go-extra: // A measured minCount's value for calendar filtering; never serialized.
MetricBucket.description: One group of a metric result. `keys` has one entry per groupBy field ([] for a grand total); a null key is the NULL bucket.

value.description: The metric: a number for count/sum/avg, a column value for min/max, null when undefined. Swift reads an omitted value as null, as before.

count.description: COUNT(*) of rows in the group.

MetricResult.description: One metric's result, in request order.

groupCount.description: Groups before groupLimit, excluding hidden groups.

error.description: The metric could not be computed; siblings are unaffected.

errorCode.description: The machine-readable code of error; present with it. A newer server may send a code this client does not know.

hiddenGroups.description: Groups removed by minCount; present whenever it is set.

other.description: The exact omitted additive quantity beyond groupLimit, when an executor computes it.

ComputedFieldCapability.description: What a canonical computed field may do in a view. Hints for client planning, never authorization.

filter.description: Host-approved canonical predicates; omitted is closed.

ComputedExecution.description: The execution envelope: profile, token, snapshot, resolved computed revisions and capabilities. A fingerprint is not authorization.

planToken.description: Empty without a handshake. Swift reads an omitted token as empty, as before.

ProjectedSchema.description: The result's schema: grouped results use the group identity field.

values.description: Non-NULL matches as text, at most limit.

hasNull.description: The population has a NULL (textarray: NULL or empty), whatever the search.

QueryResultV3.description: The answer to one QueryRequestV3. Row cells are JSON scalars, arrays (textarray) or {"computedError": code}.

distinct.description: Present exactly when the request has distinct.

ServerQuery.description: One stage (source or result) of a request. It has exactly these keys; view-only state never crosses the wire.

ErrorCode.description: Every machine-readable error code the server or a client can produce. x-codes gives each code's HTTP status (null: never sent by a server), whether a retry can succeed (yes, no, or refresh: after refreshing the handshake or reloading) and its meaning; docs/errors.md is generated from it. Decoders must accept codes they do not know.

invalid_json.description: The request body is not one well-formed JSON value.

invalid_request.description: The request is malformed outside the query itself: a missing or invalid dataset or code parameter, or an invalid stored body.

method_not_allowed.description: The endpoint does not support the HTTP method; the Allow header lists the ones it does.

forbidden.description: The host's authorization callback refused the request, or none is configured.

not_found.description: The requested stored object (such as a query snapshot code) does not exist in the caller's scope.

request_too_large.description: The request body exceeds the endpoint's byte budget.

conflict.description: A write conflicts with stored state: a computed definition changed since it was loaded, or a snapshot code already identifies different state.

quota_exceeded.description: The host's storage quota refused a write.

timeout.description: The query exceeded the server's time budget.

cancelled.description: The request was cancelled before it completed, usually because the client went away.

unavailable.description: The server cannot answer right now, for example while a data snapshot is refreshed.

internal.description: An unexpected server failure. The message is generic; details stay in server logs.

version.description: The request is not a version 3 query.

invalid_query.description: A query stage, metric list or distinct request is malformed: an unknown property, a wrong shape, or an out-of-range limit, offset, list length or name.

profile_mismatch.description: The request's profile is not the server's profile; refresh the capabilities handshake.

definition_changed.description: A computed definition's revision differs from expectedRevisions, or the revision envelope is invalid; refresh the execution handshake.

execution_expired.description: The host rejected the request's data snapshot or plan token, such as an expired or another session's; refresh the execution handshake.

definition_unavailable.description: A referenced computed definition is missing or not accessible to the caller.

definition_invalid.description: A computed definition does not compile.

datetime_value.description: A datetime value or the evaluation clock is invalid or outside the supported range.

residual_query.description: Part of the query cannot run on the server (a client-only filter or sort); refusing is safer than answering a different question.

dataset.description: The host's dataset configuration is invalid for this request.

schema.description: The host schema is invalid, for example an empty binding or a reserved field name.

source_required.description: The host did not configure a source relation.

resolver_required.description: Computed fields are referenced but the host configured no definition resolver.

resolver_scope.description: The computed definition resolver is not bound to the request's scope and dataset.

snapshot_transaction_required.description: A snapshot-bound request needs a read-only snapshot transaction from the host.

snapshot_validation_required.description: A snapshot-bound request needs a host snapshot validator.

plan_token_validation_required.description: A request with a plan token needs a host plan-token validator.

numeric_domain_required.description: A numeric SQL binding did not opt into the bounded arithmetic profile.

unknown_field.description: A field is not in the schema allowlist.

select_required.description: The request selects no field where at least one is required.

filter.description: A filter is invalid for its field: operator, value or shape.

filter_disabled.description: The field is not server-filterable (for a computed field: not in the host's filter allowlist).

sort.description: A sort term is invalid, or the field is not server-sortable.

collation_required.description: Text ordering needs a collation this profile does not provide.

unsupported_regex.description: Regex filtering or sorting is outside this server profile.

unsupported_literal.description: A text value cannot be represented (for example NUL or an unpaired surrogate).

unsupported_type.description: The value type does not support the operation (for example boolean extrema or arrays in expressions).

invalid_source_value.description: A stored source value does not match its declared type.

numeric_range.description: A numeric literal is outside the range the profile computes exactly.

identity_required.description: The operation needs a stable identity field.

duplicate_identity.description: Representative rows need unique non-null source identities within every group.

window_required.description: A shownRows metric needs a positive page limit.

syntax.description: An expression does not parse; the message says where.

unsupported_syntax.description: An expression uses syntax this server does not execute.

unsupported_function.description: An expression calls a function this server does not execute.

arity.description: A function is called with the wrong number of arguments.

type_error.description: An expression combines values of incompatible types.

aggregate_required.description: A metric expression needs an aggregate around a field.

aggregate_context.description: A row field or aggregate appears where it is not allowed, such as a bare field outside an aggregate.

aggregate_disabled.description: The field does not allow that aggregate.

paired_expression_required.description: A scatter metric needs both expression and expressionY.

dependency_cycle.description: Computed definitions depend on each other in a cycle.

invalid_metric.description: A metric is malformed: a missing or invalid field, an unknown op or malformed state.

metric_sort.description: A metric sort key is invalid for the metric.

distribution.description: A box or histogram distribution is invalid for its input.

date_grouping.description: A metric's calendar grouping is invalid: interval, zone, range or field type.

unsupported_date_grouping.description: Calendar grouping is unavailable on this execution path.

min_count_field.description: minCount's distinct or sum field is invalid.

min_count_distribution.description: minCount cannot be combined with a distribution.

group_disabled.description: The field cannot be a group key (for a computed field: not in the host's grouping allowlist).

grouping.description: A grouping definition is invalid: keys, summaries or a calendar key.

representative.description: The representative-row ordering of a grouping is invalid.

resource_limit.description: The request is well formed but exceeds a host budget: rows, groups, population, samples or work.

complexity_limit.description: An expression exceeds the complexity budget.

dependency_limit.description: Computed definitions or the revision envelope exceed the dependency budget.

expansion_limit.description: An expanded computed expression exceeds its size budget.

source_limit.description: An expression's source text is empty or exceeds its byte budget.

stage_limit.description: The query needs more SQL stages than the budget allows.

schema_limit.description: The projected schema exceeds its field budget.

capability_unsupported.description: Client only: the query needs a capability the server's handshake does not advertise (grouped rows, calendar grouping, regex source filters, ...). The request is not sent.

unexpanded_series.description: Client only: a windowed or share metric must be expanded with planMetricSeries before it is sent.

invalid.description: Query link: the encoded query state is malformed (TypeScript QueryDecodeError, Go QueryLinkError).

too_large.description: Query link: the encoded query state exceeds its size budget.

unsupported_version.description: Query link: the encoded query state has a version this build cannot read.

code.description: A newer server may send a code this client does not know; narrow with isErrorCode.

field.description: The field the error is about, when there is one.

offset.description: Where in the expression source the problem starts, when a server or client reports it (UTF-16 code units in TypeScript). The Go server does not set it yet.

metricId.description: The metric the error is about, when there is one.

QueryErrorBody.description: The JSON body of every non-2xx response from the query, computed-columns and query-snapshots handlers (Content-Type: application/json).
